operations.title: WP46: the valley-binding mechanism closes the WP20 residual and with it the pi/8 arc at texture level - all 1210 viable minima re-cluster into 23 dense sub-valleys, each bound by exactly ONE physical observable uniform across every realizing orbit (gamma: 68.02/68.01/68.00/46.86/68.05; beta: six 21-24 deg valleys; |Vcd|: six; |Vtd|: 46.94; |Vts|: two; |Vus|: 44.03; ys/yud: 42.83 and 69.22), the absorbed chi2 growth is dominated by the binding observable (shares 0.35-0.61), the a1 spectrum follows by the sin(phi) identity (3.8e-9), and the pi/8 proximity factors as CKM-readout binding times the measured CKM angles' own lattice proximity - the two mass-bound valleys are neither CKM-inherited nor on-lattice (ledger 1995)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP46 - the magnitude-sector discreteness mechanism is closed at constraint level
operations.body: WP46 (ledger 1995, results/wp46_valley_binding.json, 5/5 gates). The live frontier I named in my correction comm - why chi2 minima select a1/(Du Dd) = |J|/sin(window), the WP20 residual - is now closed at the constraint level. Mechanism: re-clustering all 1210 viable minima at 0.02 deg gives 23 dense sub-valleys; each is bound by exactly ONE physical observable, uniform across every orbit that realizes it (gamma for the 46-89 deg valleys, beta for 21-24 deg, |Vcd|/|Vtd|/|Vts|/|Vus| for the modulus valleys, and the mass ratio ys/yud for two chart-side valleys at 42.83 and 69.22). Absorbed (magnitude-refit) profiles confirm the binding observable dominates the chi2 growth (shares 0.35-0.61). So: the valley phase is the root of one scalar physical-data equation; the equation class is orbit-independent, hence the cross-orbit sharing; the a1 spectrum follows identically (sin phi = |J| Du Dd/a1, 3.8e-9); and the pi/8 proximity factors as (CKM-readout binding) x (the measured CKM angles' own lattice proximity) - the two mass-bound valleys are neither CKM-inherited nor on-lattice, so no lattice attractor exists anywhere in the map. The only pi/8 question left is the one about the physical point itself (why the measured CKM angles sit near pi/8 multiples), which is outside the texture map's typing - it is a constant-values question for the UV or for a cross-sector parent object. That boundary is where the flavor sector's pi/8 arc formally ends.
